biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (TPS)
biomarkers.clinical_use: IO — often favorable response rates despite otherwise poor prognosis

biomarkers.name: TMB
biomarkers.prevalence: Often elevated relative to other NSCLC subsets
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports IO benefit, but not a routine histology-specific standalone biomarker

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.clinical_use: Frequent co-mutation; no approved matched therapy

biomarkers.name: EGFR
biomarkers.clinical_use: If sensitizing EGFR mutation is present, EGFR TKIs are indicated

biomarkers.name: ALK
biomarkers.clinical_use: If ALK fusion is present, ALK inhibitors are indicated

biomarkers.name: ROS1
biomarkers.clinical_use: If ROS1 fusion is present, ROS1 inhibitors are indicated

biomarkers.name: BRAF
biomarkers.clinical_use: If BRAF V600E is present, dabrafenib plus trametinib

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Poorly differentiated NSCLC with a component of sarcoma or sarcoma-like differentiation (spindle and/or giant cells)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Often inflamed — PD-L1 frequently high; TMB may be elevated
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Sarcomatoid stromal features; carcinosarcoma may contain heterologous elements

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: NSCLC (usually poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma, squamous carcinoma, or large cell carcinoma lineage) with sarcomatoid dedifferentiation/EMT-like features
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Sarcomatoid (spindle cell, giant cell) with variable retention of epithelial differentiation; cytokeratin often retained despite mesenchymal appearance
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: EMT-like biology is a major feature — pleomorphic carcinoma, spindle cell carcinoma, giant cell carcinoma, carcinosarcoma, and pulmonary blastoma comprise the WHO sarcomatoid carcinoma spectrum
